system.description:
You can avoid attacks made against your Vehicle.

Prerequisite: Trained in Pilot

Effect: Once per round (as a Reaction), when you are piloting a Vehicle or Starship, you may negate a weapon hit by making a successful Pilot check. The DC of the Skill Check is equal to the result of the attack roll you wish to negate. In addition, while you are piloting a Vehicle, you are considered proficient with pilot-operated Vehicle Weapons.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
